title: Uka Eco ukax Tronoruw purintäna
intro: Mä q’ipt’at jaqiw justicia asiento ukar jak’achasïna, arupax janiw axsarañat khathatiwaykiti jan ukasti suyt’äwimpiw khathati. Uka jan waltʼäwejj sapa maynitakïnwa, ukampis tiempompejj uka jan waltʼäwejj askichañapänwa, ukhamatwa tʼaqhesiyir saräwinak chhaqtayañapäna. ¿Khitis aka almax warawaranakat sipansa quejasiñapax ist’asïna?
clues: Nayax wali llakt’ataw jutta, mä jan walt’äwin chiqapar uñjañ thaqhasa, ukax lakajaruw chint’itu.
Nayan achiktʼasitajajj janiw mä yatiyirirukikïkänti; ukat jukʼampiruw makhatäna, khititï taqe kun istʼki ukaru.
Naya contra parlapkäna uka arunakajja, nayra tiempon cadenanakampi chintʼatäkaspas ukhamänwa.
Nayajj jachaqtʼasisaw ukat amuytʼasirïta, jachʼa jachʼa tukuñajatakiw chʼajjwayäta ukat amuytʼasirïtwa.
Mä revelación ukaw saraqanïna, nayra thakhinak amukt’ayasa ukat llakinakaj uñt’ayasa.
Chachajat chʼaxwirïtwa sasaw sapxitu, ukat sutijax qhispiykitu uka jaljampiw mayakïxäna.

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
